purpose: Train-only phage protein representation capacity and resource pilot; no host infection model or target outcome evaluation
context: Ando outcomes already known; this is exploratory. Freeze representation rules before target assignment. The full host cache remains incomplete, so no partial-set interaction model is substituted.
positive_control: Copy the lexicographically first retained training phage proteome, under separate neutral query IDs; exact feature-vector equality with the training row is required for a clean mapping control.
software_deviation: MMseqs18 rather than the paper-listed15.6f452; explicit methodological adaptation, with effective parameter logs retained.
protein_normalization: Remove exactly one terminal stop, retain copies/internal sequences/X residues; assign globally unique neutral protein IDs. No target protein enters the training database or occurrence consolidation.
upstream_semantics: Cluster only training proteins; self-search training proteins against all training proteins; novel query proteins search the same all-protein training database, not representatives only.

Parse11-field MMseqs createtsv alignment records; best target is descending float32 SeqIdentity then ascending float32 E-value. Use first raw-row order for otherwise equal best hits, and report cross-family ties.
Retain families occurring in more than one selected training genome, matching the selected-subset GenoPHI path.

Collapse exactly equal training occurrence vectors into one feature, verifying tuple equality instead of relying only on a Python hash. Map novel proteins through frozen family/feature maps and OR presence. Keep explicit zero-vector rows.
outputs: All93 training protein counts, clustered family counts, filtered/consolidated feature counts
Per-proteome assigned-protein fraction and retained-feature count; explicit zero vectors; T7/T3 feature-vector equality
Cross-family best-hit ambiguities and positive control correspondence
Executable/input/command/raw-output/feature-map/vector hashes and bounded actual resource observations
interpretation: Distinct vectors only establish potential representational capacity, not strain specificity or accuracy. Equal phage vectors preclude distinguishing phage-dependent responses within this feature scheme but do not alone rule out a host-only T3 ranking. No infection score, assembly score, design or DNA export is generated.
